 Friday, November 13 Corvallis, OR 6:30 p.m. Oregon State
 vs Mississippi Valley State
 Game Coverage: Watch Oregon State to Host Delta Devils Friday
 November 11, 2026 | Men's Basketball
 Share: By: Athletic Communications 
 THE GAME:  Oregon State hosts Mississippi Valley State on Friday night.
 TELEVISION:  The game will be televised on the Pac-12 YouTube channel.
 RADIO:  The game will air live on Beaver Sports Radio Network with Jon Warren  calling the action.
 LIVE STATS:  Live stats will be available at this  link 
 QUICKLY:  Oregon State has opened the season 3-0 for the fifth-straight season ... The Beavers are looking to open the season 4-0 for the 33rd time in program history ... Oregon State has scored over 94 points in three-straight games to start the season, the first time in program history the Beavers' have reached that mark in three consecutive contests ... The Beavers are led by first-year head coach Justin Joyner, who won a national championship as an assistant coach with Michigan last season ... Oregon State's 2026-27 roster features one returning player and 12 newcomers ... Josiah Lake II is the only remaining Beaver player from the 2025-26 team. The guard was an All-WCC First Team selection last season ... Oregon State returns to the Pac-12 this season, after playing the prior two campaigns in the WCC. The new-look Pac-12 Conference also includes Gonzaga, Boise State, Washington State, Utah State, Colorado State, Texas State, Fresno State, and San Diego State ... The Beavers' nonconfernce schedule will feature a home matchup with former conference foe Arizona State ...  Twenty-two of Oregon State's regular season games will air on linear television ... Oregon State played three games this summer as part of a foreign tour in Canada. The Beavers started the trip win a win over Trinity Western and followed that up with a pair of victories over University of Victoria.
